about: Every asset subject, slot and art file set. The id is the path: subject ["/" slot] ["/" version]; version vN = approved, c<sha8> = candidate. Generated by `node scripts/assets.mjs index`; checked by `node scripts/assets.mjs check`. Layout: docs/ASSETS.md.

rows.subject: what the art is (tags live here)
rows.art: one file set (frames) with its sha256s; files[].path is relative to the repo root
rows.evidence: previews, contact sheets, GIFs and opaque renders: kept as evidence, never art

tags.kind: birds | objects | plants | scenes | packs (from the id)
tags.name: subject name, [a-z0-9_]+ (from the id)
tags.act: bird slot: canon or clips/<act>; acts idle, blink, look, hop, walk, takeoff, flight, landing, feed, drink, bathe, preen, sing, sleep (from the id)
tags.form: plant slot form: young, mature, potted, hedge (from the id)
tags.season: spring, summer, autumn, winter, all (from the id)
tags.state: bloom, fruit, dry, bare, snow, wet, leaves, rain, fog, wind; omitted = base (from the id). leaves/rain/fog/wind are ground and weather states.
tags.layer: scene layer: composite, background, ground, foreground, overlay (from the id)
tags.nativeRange: plants: list of ecoregion ids (assets/regions/regions.json: EPA Level III > II > I for North America, WWF as the global fallback), the most specific level the data supports. Empty plus needs:["nativeRange"] when not known. Native is NEVER stored as a label and NEVER restricts placement: the game computes nativeness from the yard location at runtime and uses it only as a likelihood weight for the birds that use the plant (stronger for a closer match) and as a classification for the shelf, filters and field guide. Any plant can go in any yard.
tags.cultivation: plants: wild | nursery | houseplant (houseplant implies setting: indoor)
tags.habit: plants: tree | shrub | grass | perennial | succulent | vine | groundcover
tags.gives: objects, plants: food | water | perch | cover | light (multi); what a bird gets from it
tags.food: plants, feeders: seed | berry | nectar | insect | fruit (multi)
tags.feeder: feeders: tube | platform | hopper | ground | nectar
tags.landscape: scenes, objects: coastal | valley | mountain | desert | forest | prairie | urban (multi); describes the place, works anywhere
tags.ecoregions: scenes: ecoregion ids (assets/regions/regions.json) when the scene depicts a specific place
tags.fence: scenes: what bounds the yard (cedar_privacy | picket | weathered | stucco_wall | stucco_parapet | wire_ranch | none)
tags.ground: scenes: lawn | dirt | flagstone | tile | mulch
tags.depth: scene layers, plants: far, mid, near, ground, all (scenes: layers.<layer>.depth)
tags.wind: plants, objects: rigid | sway | swing | frames
tags.part: art: a component of the slot (canopy, trunk, wind-module) rather than the whole subject
tags.app: subjects: the app catalog ids that use this subject, with the version each uses
tags.review: slots: the review-page slot ids that map to this slot (the legacy id table, layout.mjs reviewToSlot)
tags.status: wanted, new, candidate, approved, rejected, retired. Slots: wanted (no art, or the owner asked for new art), candidate (art to review), approved. Art: new (no slot yet), candidate, approved, rejected, retired.
tags.made: art: { from: current repo path, pack, on: date, by, prompt }; copies: other paths with the same bytes
tags.needs: subjects: tags still to research (never guessed)
